raw_text:
PLAN "3-Week Powerlifting Peak"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Peak SBD for meet day"

PHASES
  PHASE "Peaking Block" (3 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 75m "Heavy Squat + Bench Back-off":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
          leg_swings 1m
          hip_circles 1m
          goblet_squat 2x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x3 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          bench_press 3x4 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          plank 3x45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 70m "Heavy Bench + Deadlift Technique":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
          arm_circles 1m
          scapular_retraction 2x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x3 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          deadlift 3x3 rpe 7 rest 240 seconds
          barbell_row 3x6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 75m "Heavy Deadlift + Squat Back-off":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          cat_cow 1m
          bird_dog 2x8 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x2 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          squat 3x4 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 2m
          spinal_twist 2m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Opener Squat + Light Bench":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
          leg_swings 1m
          goblet_squat 2x6 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x2 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          bench_press 3x3 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 2x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Opener Bench + Light Deadlift":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
          arm_circles 1m
          scapular_retraction 2x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x2 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          deadlift 2x2 rpe 7 rest 240 seconds
          cable_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Opener Deadlift + Light Squat":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          cat_cow 1m
          bird_dog 2x8 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x1 rpe 8 rest 300 seconds
          squat 2x3 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          overhead_press 2x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 2m
          spinal_twist 2m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Speed Squat + Bench Primer":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
          leg_swings 1m
          goblet_squat 2x5 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x2 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 2x2 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 1m
      DAY Tuesday training 25m "Light Movement":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bird_dog 2x10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          pallof_press 2x10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 2m
          child_pose 2m
      DAY Thursday training 30m "Final Primer":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          arm_circles 1m
          scapular_retraction 2x8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x1 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 2x1 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          deadlift 1x1 rpe 6 rest 240 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 2m
          child_pose 2m
